Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL2971. Join activities to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on assays.tid. Filter target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno for compound_chembl_id. INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles; exclude rows where canonical_smiles is null. Join docs on activities.doc_id; keep only rows where at least one of pubmed_id or doi is non-null. LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key only; do not derive the document through compound_records. Compute pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id, falling back to doi. Return DISTINCT rows over exactly: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Sort by all 12 output columns.
